faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) for filling up vacant posts in the School of Management Studies on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in CUSAT recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Technical Assistant under the notification with Advt No Ad.G2/SMS/T.S/D.W/2019.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electronics, MCA, M.Sc. (Computer Science), or a 3-year Diploma of a Polytechnic in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CUSAT Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 and 40 years, with usual age relaxations applicable for reserved categories like SC, ST, and Backward communities.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Technical Assistant post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹.41,970/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply online for CUSAT Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 26-10-2026. Applicants must complete their submission before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is ₹950/-, while SC/ST candidates are required to pay ₹195/-.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on the marks obtained in their qualifying degree examinations.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent after applying online?
faq.answer: The signed hard copy of the application along with required documents must reach the 'Registrar, Administrative Office, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kochi-22' on or before the specified due date.
